verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a cloud browser SaaS, but the evidence documents no way to export all of a user's account data (profiles, sessions, recordings, history) in open formats or to offboard. Scrape and Extract outputs in markdown, HTML or JSON concern scraped web content, not the user's own data. rrweb and MP4 recordings are a separate recording feature, and profile docs never mention exporting browser state, so neither supports a full data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
